intent: Add a scrollbar for the second axis of a ScrollArea.
typical_uses: The horizontal scrollbar of a ScrollArea whose content is wider than it

dont_use_when.situation: A vertical scrollbar for a ScrollArea

instead.note: ScrollArea already renders its own vertical ScrollBar.

invariants.text: ScrollBar reads its ScrollArea through Base UI context; rendered with no ScrollArea around it, the primitive throws.
Without `keepMounted` the bar is not mounted while the content does not overflow along its own axis; with `keepMounted` it stays in the DOM either way.

render.states: render replaces the rendered element with one the caller supplies
render.because: Base UI's render prop takes an element or a function of the scrollbar's own state, so its type is a union of a React element and a callback - the compiler emits one JSON type per property.

style.states: style accepts a function of the scrollbar's state as well as a plain style object
style.because: Base UI widens React's `CSSProperties` to `CSSProperties | ((state) => CSSProperties)` so a caller can style off the primitive's own state (orientation, scrolling, hovering, ...). The compiler emits one JSON type per property, so nothing is asserted; the kit's own styling goes through scroll-area.module.css, not through this.

unexposed_parts.reason: The draggable thumb; ScrollBar renders it as its only child with the kit's thumb class, and the kit exports no component for it.

good.title: A horizontal bar beside the built-in vertical one

bad.title: A scrollbar with no ScrollArea around it
bad.why: ScrollBar has no scroll state of its own; with no ScrollArea ancestor the primitive throws instead of rendering.
